stem: Which sentence from paragraph 2 in the article “Cultural Cooking Connections” shows that cooking is a skill that families share with one another?

options.text: He has fond memories of working with his grandmother to turn masa into handmade tortillas.
Food author Samin Nosrat says making bread with your hands is a mindful experience.
She mentions turning the dough, feeling the wetness.
“That kind of stuff, to me, is what makes us human.”
